newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen moving up, but gains limited.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen moving up, but gains limited.

text.p: Thai stocks were expected to trade higher on Tuesday bouyed by Wall Street's overnight gain and a rise in other regional markets, brokers said.
But any sharp gains would be limited by an underlying caution in sentiment amid lingering worries about high non-performing loans in the finance sector, brokers said.
"There might be some buying interest after Wall Street's gain. But any aggresive buying is unlikely as sentiment remains weak," said one broker at Nava Finance and Securities.
The SET index on Monday ended up 3.84 points at 534.46 on trade of 9.8 billion baht.-- Anuchit Nguyen (662) 652-0642
